title: Numerical Jacobian Checker & the −R[p]× Jacobian
hints: Column k of J is (f(x + eps·e_k) − f(x − eps·e_k)) / (2·eps). Evaluate f(x) once to learn the output size m.
Numerical rotation Jacobian: wrap δ ↦ R·expSO3(δ)·p in a lambda and call numericalJacobian at δ = 0. Never perturb R's 9 entries directly.
Analytic: R·Exp(δ)·p ≈ R(I + [δ]×)p = Rp − R[p]×δ, so J = −R·skew(p).
